decision.explanation: The question asks for the specific 'Wikimedia project' for which Marijke Lagerlöf was listed on a focus list. Source D1 explicitly states she was added to the focus list of 'WikiProject Badminton', which is a named Wikimedia project (D1S4, D1S12). Source D2 states she is on the focus list of the 'NL Gendergap maintenance project', which is described as an initiative/project within the Dutch-language Wikipedia ecosystem (D2S7-D2S9). Both are valid distinct projects mentioned in the text. 'Dutch-language Wikipedia' (Candidate C2) is rejected because it is the language edition/platform itself, not the specific project name identified as having the focus list in the context of the question's phrasing ('listed on the focus list for'). The text distinguishes between the platform (Wikipedia) and the specific project (WikiProject Badminton / NL Gendergap maintenance project).
